services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to have you back to normal within the hour, day or night.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Servicing
services.desc: Annual servicing keeps your boiler efficient and safe. We diagnose faults quickly and source parts the same day to minimise downtime.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New boiler fitted with a 10-year warranty and full system commissioning. We advise on the right model for your home and budget.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Complete heating system design, installation, and commissioning. We balance efficiency with comfort, and handle all pipe work and radiators.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Installation of showers, baths, taps, and sink units. We manage pipework, waste connections, and ensure everything is tested and certified.

services.title: Radiator & Pipe Repairs
services.desc: Cold radiators, leaking joints, and corrosion fixed quickly. We bleed air, balance systems, and repair or replace damaged sections on the spot.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was fed up seeing homeowners overcharged by cowboys.
about_para_1: Elite Plumbing & Heating was founded in 2006 with one simple aim: to provide honest, fast, and fairly priced plumbing and heating services to Northampton and the surrounding area. Over nearly two decades, we've built a reputation for turning up on time, diagnosing problems correctly, and fixing them without unnecessary upselling. All our engineers are Gas Safe registered and fully insured.
about_para_2: We've completed over 2,400 jobs — from emergency callouts at midnight to planned boiler replacements — and most of our work comes from repeat customers and referrals. What sets us apart is our commitment to transparency: we'll always explain what needs doing, give you a fair quote, and stick to it. When you call Elite Plumbing, you get a local, experienced tradesperson, not a call centre.
reviews_heading: What Northampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a leaking radiator before Christmas. Mark came out the same evening and had it sorted in 45 minutes. Honest pricing, brilliant service. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Sarah T.

reviews.text: Our boiler packed in on a Sunday morning. Called Elite at 8am and they were here by 9:30. New part fitted, system bled, back up and running by lunchtime. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Used them for the annual service and they spotted a fault with the pump that could have caused problems. Fixed it same day. Fair quote, no messing about. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michelle R.
